bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 10 to 13 ft building to 13 to 15 feet this afternoon and continuing into Saturday morning. Bar conditions rough becoming severe this afternoon and tonight with breakers. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 200 AM Friday, 230 PM Friday, 245 AM Saturday. The afternoon ebb today will be strong.
